messages:
maria: Heads-up :eyes: seeing drift in A/B when branch-throttle + telemetry-sampling are both enabled. Variant B shows p95 spike but only in sampled traces.

 devon: Confirmed. Looks like our sampling is biased away from cold-start/warmup traffic so observer underestimates early latency.

 aj: Could be batching/seq-length skew too 12; sampled set has different token distributions.

 lucas: Proposal: add deterministic sampling bucket to rollout metadata. Sidecar/runtime injects X-Rollout-Bucket computed as HMAC(seed_salt, tenant_id) % 10000 so runtime+observer sample the same requests for a route.

 kevin: Privacy note: salted per-tenant and rotatable seed required. For Private installs we should support KMS-backed seed material and document rotation.

 sre-bot: alert: variant_b.latency.p95 > 600ms (5m) fired at 4311110025 12 acknowledged.

 maria: Interface boundary: control plane decides traffic distribution only. Rollout manifests carry telemetry/sampling metadata (seed_salt, mode, rate, mirror hints). Runtime/sidecars only use that metadata to align sampling; they must not make distribution decisions from sampled telemetry.

 devon: Alternative: mirror a tiny fraction of traffic to the canary (shadow warmup) to prime caches without sending user-facing traffic. Upside: accurate cold-start visibility. Downside: extra cost and potential side-effects.

 aj: Implementation idea: rollout.metadata.sampling_mode = ("seeded"|"probabilistic"|"mirror"), sampling_rate, seed_salt, warmup.mirror_ratio, warmup.eviction_protect_secs. Observer and runtime honor policy.

 lucas: Minimal API change: PATCH /routes/{id}/rollout -> { "metadata": { "sampling_mode": "seeded", "sampling_rate": "0.01", "seed_salt": "<opaque>" }}. Sidecar sets header and optionally emits mirror request when warmup.mirror_ratio > 0.

 kevin: Ops plan: gate behind FF, opt-in per-route. Start with seeded sampling (1%) + mirror (0.1%) for a subset of tenants. Run 14-day validation comparing sampled vs full-trace metrics. Tune alerts to require min_sample_count to avoid flapping.

 maria: Add metric we can compute server-side: sample_overlap = |sampled 6 full-trace| / |full-trace|. If overlap < 0.6 mark sampling unreliable and fall back to higher mirror fraction.

 aj: Pseudocode for sidecar header + mirror:```python
# sidecar pseudocode
bucket = int(hmac_sha256(seed_salt, tenant_id)[:4], 16) % 10000
if bucket < int(sampling_rate * 10000):
    req.headers['X-Rollout-Bucket'] = str(bucket)
# mirror warmup copy
if random() < warmup_mirror_ratio:
    mirror_req = copy(req)
    mirror_req.headers['X-Shadow'] = 'true'
    send_to(canary_backend, mirror_req)
```

 devon: Test matrix: compare seeded vs probabilistic sampling, mirror on/off, varying mirror ratios. Track p50/p95/p99, cold-start percent, kv-cache-miss, model-token-drop, embed-failure-rate.

 lucas: I'll draft RFC + lightweight PoC sidecar. Proposed timeline: RFC in 5 days, PoC in 10 days, validation run 14 days after that.

 kevin: Ops checklist: FF, per-tenant seed rotation docs (Private), KMS integration note, alert de-noising, escalation playbook if mirrored traffic causes regressions.

 maria: Decision: move forward with seeded sampling + small shadow warmup mirror + rollout metadata for warmup hints (eviction_protect). Owner: lucas. Followups: RFC + PoC + telemetry tests.

 sre-bot: Actions logged: lucas#create-rfc, aj#sidecar-poc, devon#telemetry-matrix, kevin#ops-runbook.
